scope: Original Gunman and Gunman Victim scripts with bounded native effect arithmetic; no original behavior added or whole-encounter acceptance.

native_comparison.store_guard: Instruction-level integer-store spans; no memory-write hook.
native_comparison.scope: Constructed Gunman/victim script states and real pose, animation, callback-clear, RNG, effect-factory and effect-color arithmetic. Allocation, empty attachment, orientation, rotation, movement, notification and sound use explicit contracts. Histories retain buffers/RNG and explicitly inject tick/frame/action inputs; they do not run a complete engine frame or tick the effects. Excludes natural construction, populated attachment graphs, linked-effect mode, effect ticking/rendering, audio and PS1 CPU timing.

construction_contract_note: effect_create includes allocation and construction; it returns null or an already initialized fixture. entity_create_effect executes natively. Attachment contracts make no graph changes.
public_file_hash_basis: Raw bytes in the verified local execution checkout; ordinary Git text conversion may change documentation line endings. Native-tested Gunman sources and range inputs use explicit LF attributes.
